summary: Hood River County summit lookout site: 1929 platform, 1934 L-4 cab, gone by the 1940s. Only broken glass and cable remain; the summit is reached on foot from Wahtum Lake.

staffing.status: lookout recorded in 1934 and announced for 1935; no later staffing in these sources

access.note: Summit reached on foot from the Wahtum Lake Trailhead by a short hike, per the Oregon Hikers guide

visit.trail_note: About 1.5 miles from the Wahtum Lake Trailhead to the summit

notes_for_editor: The brief's kind 'ground' is neither confirmed nor contradicted: the register describes a firefinder platform with a tent (1929) and an L-4 cab (1934), but no source says whether the cab stood on a tower. The register dates the first setup to 1929, while a July 1930 photo note on the Forest Lookouts page calls the site undeveloped; left as a conflict. The 1934 incident was an unextinguished campfire, not a wildfire. The 1943 Portland Filter Center entry appears only on the Forest Lookouts page and is reported as written. Access is public per the Oregon Hikers guide, which is not an agency statement; check Mount Hood National Forest before a trip. The 2017 Eagle Creek fire is not mentioned by any source used here. No photos were added.
